title: Injective modules on a ringed site restrict surjectively along monomorphisms
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative unital rings on it. Work in a common universe containing the objects, arrows, covering index sets, ring values and module values [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $I$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the category $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every monomorphism $m:W\to T$ in $\mathcal C$, the restriction homomorphism $I(T)\to I(W)$ is surjective. No subcanonicality, covering property of $m$, or injectivity of the underlying abelian sheaf is assumed.

source.place: Tag 093X, label lemma-restriction-along-monomorphism-surjective, lines 1962-2009; Stacks conventions.tex line 51: rings are commutative with 1

proof.text: Let R be the ring sheaf underlying O. Module sheafification is left adjoint to the inclusion (expressed in Mathlib as forget followed by restriction of scalars along the identity). Since module sheafification preserves finite limits, it preserves monomorphisms. Transfer injectivity of I along this adjunction to the underlying presheaf M of R-modules, using Injective.injective_of_adjoint. This packages the sheafification and extension steps of the source argument without any assumption on the underlying abelian sheaf.

Apply the free R-module presheaf functor to yoneda.map m to obtain a : P_W → P_T. At V this is Finsupp.mapDomain along f ↦ f ≫ m. Monicity of m makes this indexing function injective by cancellation; Finsupp.mapDomain_injective therefore gives componentwise injectivity. PresheafOfModules.mono_of_injective makes a a monomorphism. The functor construction already supplies semilinear naturality.

For s in I(W), freeYonedaEquiv.symm gives b : P_W → M. Injectivity of M extends b across a, yielding g : P_T → M with a ≫ g = b. Take t = freeYonedaEquiv g. Applying freeYonedaEquiv to the factorization gives freeYonedaEquiv (a ≫ g) = s. Naturality of g along m identifies the left side with M(m)(t): the free map a sends the identity generator over W to e_m, and restriction of the identity generator over T is also e_m. Thus I(m)(t) = s, proving surjectivity.

proof_origin.place: Tag 093X, lemma-restriction-along-monomorphism-surjective, lines 1970-2009; formalized by Q7 using the equivalent injectivity transfer through the exact module-sheafification adjunction. The free-presheaf evaluation is sites-modules.tex Tag 03DI and Remark 03EJ; exact sheafification is Tag 03EI.

It matches Stacks 093X (sites-cohomology.tex l.1962-2009) hypothesis by hypothesis: ringed site with commutative O (conventions l.51), a monomorphism m, and I injective in Mod(O), with surjective restriction as the conclusion. I checked the tag-to-label mappings for 093X, 03DI, 03EJ, 03CY, 03EI and 03DA in tags/tags. Every cited statement says what its step takes. Step 1: free-Yoneda leaf (beta -> beta_U(e_id)) plus the module-sheafification adjunction. Step 2: I checked naturality of e_phi -> e_{m phi} by hand. Step 3: m monic gives a coordinatewise injection, hence a mono in PMod. Step 4: the ringed-site sheafification leaf preserves finite limits, hence monos, for the actual O, not just a constant ring. Step 5: Mod(O) is abelian on a small site, and the identification works because the unit satisfies a^#.eta_W = eta_T.a, giving b_t(e_m) = I(m)(t). Small cases all hold: m = id, O = 0, an empty covering of T (both sides zero), and Z/2 on a point, where the module is injective but not abelian-injective and the proof never uses abelian injectivity. Monicity is used only in Step 3. No new nodes. The nearest DAG node, lem-weil-pbc-injective-sheaf-mono-restriction, is the abelian special case (O = Z_C), not a duplicate. All cited nodes are Mathlib leaves or definitions, so there is no route departure and no tool_uses. Blueprint ancestry is thm-pur-with-support-exactness Steps 3-4 via the parent, consistent with main-20261015. No SGA source, no cycle, no target touched.
